# Genesis Apocryphon Column 11 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 11 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed

---

**11:1** [...] offerings [...] and he built an altar [...]

**11:2** [...] and Noah offered [...] burnt offerings upon the altar [...]

**11:3** [...] and the Lord smelled [...] the pleasing aroma [...]

**11:4** [...] and God blessed [...] Noah and his sons [...]

**11:5** [...] the covenant [...] between me and you [...]

**11:6** [...] and between every living creature [...]

**11:7** [...] never again [...] a flood to destroy [...]

**11:8** [...] the bow [...] in the cloud [...]

**11:9** [...] a sign of the covenant [...] for all generations [...]

**11:10** [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 11 is almost entirely lost. Fragments preserve the post-flood sacrifice and covenant narrative from Genesis 8:20-9:17. The 'pleasing aroma,' divine blessing, covenant promise, and the bow as sign are all attested in the surviving words.*
